frontend/public/cards.json / cards_en.json / cards_de.json are the real card dumps behind cards-data.js and are NOT enumerated here (out of TCU scope).

ReturnTo files (540xx scenario cards, 54xxx cards) are enumerated with chapter prefix "returnTo:"; they are not part of the 9-scenario base port but define the variant content the target repo may later need.

Encounter-set definition files for shared TCU sets use chapter "shared:<set>"; ReturnTo-only replacement sets (ChillingMists, BloodthirstySpirits, CityOfTheDamned, Hexcraft, ImpendingEvils, UnspeakableFate, UnstableRealm) use "returnToSet:<Set>".
